canonical_project: Nxtra by Airtel Mumbai-II hyperscale campus, Chandivali
notes: Hyperscale campus at Boomerang, Chandivali Farm Road, Andheri East (Mumbai Suburban); announced 2020 as one of two large Nxtra Maharashtra campuses; reported ~90 MW hyperscale, aggregators list ~58 MW power on 600,000 sq ft.
